caption: Realistic freestanding contemporary storage cabinet.
description: Realistic freestanding contemporary storage cabinet. Clear furniture construction with: - one main cabinet body - two front doors - two clearly visible door handles - several internal shelves visible when possible - four short support legs or a clearly defined base - realistic thickness for panels and doors Modern restaurant, dining room or home furniture style. Simple elegant design, realistic proportions and manufacturable construction. Medium detail with clearly separated structural components. Single complete cabinet, centered and isolated. No objects stored inside, no decorations on top, no room, no wall, no background scene. Avoid carved ornaments, excessive bevels and unnecessary small details. Game-ready realistic 3D asset.
